title: N60: Gamma decline does NOT affect VT effectiveness — VT benefit is vol-of-vol driven
description: Tested VT effectiveness across 6 bi-annual periods (2014-2025) while gamma declined -53%. Sharpe difference: -0.44, 0.00, -0.18, -0.04, +0.06, -0.04 — no declining trend. MaxDD improvement: positive in 5/6 periods, largest during COVID (+19.6pp). The gamma decline is irrelevant to VT because VT's mechanism is volatility scaling (vol-of-vol dependent), not leverage exploitation.
